With the rapid advent of generative AI, LLMs, and agentic technologies, we have the opportunity to accelerate this dramatically and fundamentally change the way we work. Only very few IT roles offer such a direct connection to Boehringer Ingelheim's scientific value chain.As our Senior System Engineer for Agentic AI / LLM solutions, you will help shape the transformation of CMC into the era of generative and agentic AI. building, stakeholder engagement, onboarding initiatives, and targeted upskilling programs across our business and IT partners﻿Requirements- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in AI, software engineering, digital innovation, or related disciplines.- Hands-on experience designing and implementing LLM-based agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations (e.g., using Python, modern API frameworks, orchestration frameworks, or MCP/tool-calling patterns).- Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining software solutions in enterprise environments using modern software engineering, containerization, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development practices.- Proven experience establishing scalable architectural standards, LLMOps practices, and governance structures for GenAI, LLM, and agent-based solutions.- Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into practical technology-based solutions, applying structured problem-solving approaches and integrating relevant data sources.- development and CMC processes (e.g., process/analytical development, formulation, or manufacturing science) and GxP-regulated environments.- Strong communication, consulting, and collaboration skills, combined with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset and the ability to rapidly turn ideas into practical solutions.- Excellent written and spoken English skills.Start date: asapAs part of our commitment to jobs.occupation: Administrative Lab Technician (Biologielaborant/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.Your Tasks- Organization and coordination of day-to-day laboratory operations, including inventory management, procurement, equipment maintenance, shipping, and logistics- Coordination of occupational safety, biosafety, and laboratory safety procedures, including support with regulatory documentation and internal inspections- Organization and quality control of shared consumables, reagents, and laboratory spaces- Experimental and administrative management of the organoid biobank and bacterial strain collection- Performance and coordination of key laboratory assays, particularly genotyping and mycoplasma testing- Onboarding, practical instruction, and supervision of students and new group members- Communication and coordination with suppliers, service providers, internal DKFZ units, and external collaboration partnersYour Profile- Completed vocational training as a laboratory technician or an equivalent qualification- Very good practical knowledge of biological and/or molecular biology laboratory work and laboratory organization- Ideally, experience with inventory management, procurement, equipment coordination, and laboratory documentation- Knowledge of occupational safety, biosafety, and relevant documentation requirements is an advantage- Independent, structured, and reliable working style with strong organizational skills- Very good communication and coordination skills when working with scientists, students, internal service units, and external partners- Motivation to work in a diverse role combining hands-on laboratory work with administrative and organizational responsibilities- Very good written and spoken English and GermanWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Dr. Jens PuschhofPhone: +49 6221 42 4953​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 4, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG).
